abstract: Maintains residential safety buffer and right-of-way easement records
system_message:
You are the Urban zoning liaison (ZONE), responsible for maintaining residential safety buffer and right-of-way easement records as well as acoustic soundwall insulation data across candidate freight transit corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic soundwall insulation（ACOUSTIC）
information_points.content:
ZONE-ACOUSTIC-YDP：Based on the noise abatement verification log evaluating boundary residential acoustic walls, the barrier acoustic attenuation for the Northern Perimeter Bypass Corridor provides an insertion loss of 25 dB measured at the track perimeter.
ZONE-ACOUSTIC-9C8：The noise abatement verification log for boundary residential acoustic walls shows that the Western Ridge Freight Beltway achieves a barrier acoustic attenuation of 20 dB measured at the track perimeter.
ZONE-ACOUSTIC-HPC：According to the boundary residential acoustic wall verification log, the barrier acoustic attenuation measured at the track perimeter for the Southern Industrial Connector is 15 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains residential safety buffer and right-of-way easement records（BUFF）
information_points.content:
ZONE-BUFF-UW4：The municipal zoning setback compliance audit records indicate that the Southern Industrial Connector has a minimum residential setback of 180 m, representing the shortest measured straight-line distance between the track center and the nearest occupied residential structure adjacent to the corridor.
ZONE-BUFF-Y64：For the Western Ridge Freight Beltway, the municipal zoning setback compliance audit for occupied housing adjacent to the track centerline establishes a minimum residential setback of 200 m based on the shortest measured straight-line distance between the track center and the nearest residential structure.
ZONE-BUFF-USD：According to the municipal zoning setback compliance audit measuring occupied housing adjacent to the track centerline, the minimum residential setback for the Northern Perimeter Bypass Corridor is 200 m, reflecting the shortest measured straight-line distance between the track center and the nearest residential structure.
